verdict.rationale: Portkey claims granular cost tracking and cost-optimization metrics across all requests routed through its unified gateway. It offers a single pane for every provider and model, plus spend budgets enforced per API key and at org and workspace level. Together these cover centralized cross-provider spend tracking with key- and team/workspace-level attribution. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of per-model and per-user spend breakdowns, documentation of the cost analytics dashboard itself (most claims are marketing-level), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
